q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT B.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER , COUNT(DISTINCT B.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW AS A LEFT JOIN FOLLOW AS B ON A.FOLLOWER = B.FOLLOWEE WHERE B.FOLLOWEE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY B.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY B.FOLLOWEE
